purpose: Defines a machine-readable record for goal invariants, their evidence basis, contestation process, revision triggers, and constraint-accountability links.

rules.constraint_accountability: A constraint is valid only while traceable to at least one active invariant under current operating conditions.
rules.drift_detection: Constraint Drift is present when the constraint-to-invariant accountability chain is lost, obscured, or no longer defensible.
rules.revision: An invariant may be revised when evidence shows that it no longer holds under transformation pressure.
rules.retirement: An invariant may be retired when it fails contestation or no longer represents preserved goal identity.

non_scope: Does not define a new CANON state variable.
Does not define a new CANON operator.
Does not replace the executable CANON system spec.
Does not directly modify Pi_K, F, or K without a separate executable patch.
